facts.fact: As of 24 February 2026 the BCEAO had authorised nine institutions in Burkina Faso (including Orange Money, Coris Bank International and Ecobank) to offer PI-SPI instant payment services to the public.

BFA.note: Nothing on consumer protection rules or redress.

facts.fact: Nine institutions in Burkina Faso are authorised to offer services on the BCEAO's WAEMU-wide PI-SPI instant payment platform, as of 24 February 2026.

BFA.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: Through PI-SPI, transfers in Burkina Faso run between banks, financial institutions and e-money operators, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week; nine institutions including Orange Money are authorised as of 24 February 2026.

BFA.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
